# sortmy.london

> A free civic wayfinder for London. Ask a question in plain English (plus a postcode or
> place), and it signposts you to the official public-service record — it never gives advice,
> never invents an answer, and always shows the date + a link to confirm at the source.

sortmy.london answers questions about London public services by routing them to one of a small
set of real workflows, each backed by an official public register. No account, no cookies, no
tracking beyond anonymous page-view counts. Results are a weekly-to-daily snapshot of official
data, not a live scrape — every result states its own freshness date and links back to the
official page so nothing here should be trusted as the final word.

## API

- [POST /api/run](https://sortmy.london/api/run) — run a civic-lookup workflow. JSON body
  `{"prompt": "<free text>"}`, optional `?usecase=<id>` to bypass routing, optional
  `?demo=1` for a deterministic sample run. Returns a `text/event-stream` (Server-Sent Events,
  AG-UI protocol) stream of the routed workflow's results. Rate-limited per IP.
- [GET /api/freshness](https://sortmy.london/api/freshness) — JSON: the last-ingested date and
  row count for every backing corpus, so a caller can verify how current the data is before
  trusting a result.
- [/openapi.json](https://sortmy.london/openapi.json) — machine-readable description of both
  endpoints above.

## Workflows (skills)

- [Sort My Care](https://sortmy.london/?usecase=sort-my-care) — find NHS and public health
  services near a postcode (GPs, pharmacies, hospitals, dentists). Source: Care Quality
  Commission.
- [Sort My Wander](https://sortmy.london/?usecase=sort-my-wander) — find parks, green spaces
  and listed heritage sites near a postcode. Source: Historic England & Ordnance Survey.
- [Sort My Food Hygiene](https://sortmy.london/?usecase=sort-my-food-hygiene) — official food
  hygiene ratings for restaurants and takeaways near a postcode. Source: Food Standards Agency.
- [Sort My Scam Check](https://sortmy.london/?usecase=sort-my-scam-check) — check whether a
  firm is on the FCA's register of authorised financial businesses. Source: Financial Conduct
  Authority. **Sample data only** — not a live regulatory lookup; always confirm on the real
  FCA register.

## Demo-only (never auto-routed; reachable only via an explicit link)

- [Sort My Route](https://sortmy.london/?usecase=sort-my-route) — plans a step-free public
  transport route between two London places. Canned demo, no live transport API behind it.
- [Founder's Copilot](https://sortmy.london/?usecase=founders-copilot) — a demo copilot
  matching London startup founders to funding and incorporation steps. Canned demo.

## Optional

- [/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json](https://sortmy.london/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json) —
  the same workflow list above, machine-readable.
- [/.well-known/api-catalog](https://sortmy.london/.well-known/api-catalog) — RFC 9727 API
  catalog for the two endpoints above.
- [/auth.md](https://sortmy.london/auth.md) — this API needs no authentication; see for the
  actual constraints (rate limiting, no API key).
- [Source (GitHub)](https://github.com/qte77/ldnmxx-hack) — each workflow is a JSON file, not a
  rebuild; see `usecases/*.json` and `shared/usecaseCatalog.ts` for the single source of truth
  this file and the JSON catalogs above are both generated from by hand — open an issue if
  either drifts from `usecases/*.json`.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/qte77/ldnmxx-hack/blob/main/AGENTS.md) — operating rules for AI
  coding agents working in this repo (conventions, workflow, locked decisions).
